name: pasokhban-landing
description: Persian RTL landing page for Pasokhban (WordPress AI chat & live support plugin). React + Vite + TypeScript, built as a static site.

scripts.build:standalone: tsc --noEmit && STANDALONE=1 vite build --outDir dist-standalone --emptyOutDir && node scripts/standalone-html.mjs dist-standalone
scripts.package: npm run build:standalone && node scripts/package-zip.mjs dist-standalone
